description: Adjust a custom background that already exists and render a new preview, e.g. after create_background when the preview is close but not right. `description` is only the change to make ('make the floor darker and the lighting warmer'); everything else in the scene is kept, and `reference_image_urls` can show the look to move towards. The background is updated in place under the same `id` and name, so later generate_background calls use the refined scene; photos already generated are not changed. Works on custom backgrounds only, not built-in ones; to start a different scene use create_background. Returns the new preview image. Costs one credit; a rejected or failed request is not charged.
name: refine_background
title: Refine custom background
